name: Hermit Thrush
facts: Call pattern: one long, clear opening note followed by airy, flute-like phrases, each sung at a different pitch.
Habitat: the forest floor of northern woods. Flicks its rusty tail up, then lowers it slowly.
Migration: passes through the Midwest in spring and fall. The only spotted thrush that regularly winters in the United States.
